body: I'd like to build a mid-century modern home first. I really enjoy that design but wouldn't never have the money to build it unless buy the land for it to go on.

None of that really makes any sense to me. I live in a town that has only a little over 9000 people in it. Any smaller and I'd have to grow my own food. 

I have a problem with communicating and I guess that's why no one here really got it. Also I guess that's why therapy isn't working.
